description: This file defines classes and structures related to cgroup memory and processor information within the WPEFramework's process container namespace. It includes classes for managing memory info, processor info, and gathering cgroup metrics such as memory usage and CPU core utilization.

classes.name: CGroupMemoryInfo
classes.description: Represents memory information for a cgroup, including allocated, resident, and shared memory metrics.

classes.name: CGroupProcessorInfo
classes.description: Holds CPU core usage data and provides total and per-core CPU usage metrics.

classes.name: CGroupMetrics
classes.description: A helper class to collect and provide cgroup-related metrics such as memory and CPU usage.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage details for the cgroup, including total allocated memory, resident memory, and shared memory.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CPU core usage information for the cgroup.
